difficulty_reason: For f_1 : A_1 -> A and f_2 : A_2 -> A with f_2 surjective, the pushout Y' = Y ⊔_X X' of schemes identifies Spec(A_1 x_A A_2); the (RS) square for X at this pushout is an equivalence of fibre categories, and F(B) being the category of objects of X_{Spec(B)} with an identification with x_0 over k inherits the equivalence, which is the (RS)-2-categorical criterion for a deformation category.
